sourceRules: Traffic and rate metrics remain selected-property and selected-campaign scoped.
Financial values must use fixed documented source precedence; valid zero is authoritative and unavailable must not become zero.

Current Commit 5 locally applies provider-to-persisted-to-configured-breakdown precedence and preserves affected last-good stored values when required native, revenue, or spend inputs are unavailable.
Current Commit 6 locally prevents blocked, insufficient, unavailable, or preserved-last-good values from being treated as verified breaches by backend alert, email, bell, and Notifications consumers.

Current Commit 7 locally prevents loading, failed, unavailable, stale/last-good, blocked, or insufficient KPI values from being scored, pulsed, or described as verified performance by browser consumers.
Current Commit 8 locally requires exact KPI updated/skipped/failed results and selected-row freshness proof before source-lifecycle alert sweeps or report generation continue.
Current Commit 9 locally aligns KPI progress capacity and makes exact notification hiding plus KPI child/parent deletion atomic and retryable.
Custom and unsupported KPI values must not be overwritten by guessed recomputation.
windowRules: The intended traffic and rate contract is 30 completed reporting days in the campaign reporting timezone.
Engagement Rate must be weighted from authoritative inputs.
Current Commit 4 locally aligns persisted recompute, notification enrichment, and read-only comparison inputs to this contract; deployed and external parity remain pending.
Current Commit 7 labels traffic/rate KPI browser consumers as 30 completed reporting days in the campaign reporting timezone and financial KPI browser consumers as campaign-to-date.
ownershipRules: Every KPI read and mutation must prove actor, campaign, KPI owner, and exact platform scope.
Schedulers and reports must fail closed when campaign, property, source, or exact refreshed KPI identity cannot be proven.
Delete and visibility behavior must not affect another campaign, client, platform, KPI, or notification.
